name: Clubhouse Camp
description_short: A summer camp for ages 6–12 at the Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich's Rebecca S. Breed Clubhouse on Horseneck Lane. Campers get swim lessons, STEM-based academic enrichment, sports, special trips and weekly theme activities.
swim_waterfront_notes: Indoor 25-meter pool on site; campers get indoor swim lessons and open swim time.

source.title: Clubhouse Camp : Summer Camps : What We Do : Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich
